brief: Three bases arranged around an empty spot, with a bay tray standing in that spot.
costSource: token-equivalent at Muse Spark Open shared rates, info only: the Dedicated Endpoint bills GPU seconds while up (.spend/modal-dedicated.jsonl)

requirements.requirement: Three bases arranged around an empty spot
requirements.evidence: Three full hex bases at (0,0), (0,1) and (-1,0) – refs piece:0,0,0;full, piece:0,1,0;full, piece:-1,0,0;full – all adjacent to the same empty cell at q=-1,r=1, leaving that central hex empty.

requirements.requirement: A bay tray standing in that empty spot
requirements.evidence: Full bay tray bay:0#-1,1#bay0 (hex-bin-bay-s-full-solid) placed at q=-1,r=1 with k=0, bolted to the three surrounding bases. BOM shows 1× hex-bin-bay-s-full-solid.

finish.summary: Built three full bases in a triangle around the empty cell (-1,1) and installed a full south-bay tray in that cell, capped open faces and bolted joints – meshClash clear.

lines.label: M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

events.text: Three bases hugging an empty center with a bay tucked inside — I'll frame it up.
